# Rightmove UK Property Scraper

Rightmove is the UK's largest property portal. This actor turns its public search pages and listing pages into clean, structured dataset records — for sale, to rent, new-build homes and student accommodation — anywhere in the UK, with price, size, tenure, agent contact details, coordinates, photos, key features and listing dates.

## What this actor does

- Searches Rightmove for sale, rental, new-build or student property by city, town, region, outcode or full postcode
- Accepts Rightmove search URLs, individual property URLs, or bare property IDs and keeps the filters already present in a pasted URL
- Applies Rightmove's own filters for price, bedrooms, property type, radius, furnishing, garden/parking, sold-subject-to-contract and let-agreed listings
- Paginates through Rightmove's result pages up to your requested item count and removes duplicate listings
- Enriches individual property URLs with the full description, floor plans, EPC images, brochures, nearest stations, council tax band and postcode
- Omits any field a listing does not provide — there are no nulls, empty strings or empty lists in the output

## Output per property

Search records include:

- `propertyId`, `propertyUrl` — Rightmove's property ID and the listing page
- `address`, `summary` — display address and the listing summary text
- `price`, `priceDisplay`, `priceQualifier`, `priceFrequency`, `currency` — numeric price, Rightmove's formatted price, qualifier, rental period and currency
- `bedrooms`, `bathrooms`, `displaySize`, `sizeSqFt`, `sizeSqM` — room counts and floor area when stated
- `propertyType`, `propertyTypeFullDescription`, `tenure` — sub-type, full type description and tenure
- `latitude`, `longitude` — map coordinates
- `agentName`, `branchName`, `agentPhone`, `agentUrl` — estate-agent and branch details
- `imageUrl`, `imageUrls` — primary photo and up to 15 photo URLs
- `keyFeatures`, `tags` — bullet-point features and listing tags
- `listingStatus`, `listingDate`, `listedDate`, `addedOrReduced` — listing state and dates
- `letAvailableDate` — availability date for rentals
- `numberOfImages`, `numberOfFloorplans`, `numberOfVirtualTours` — media counts
- `feesApply`, `students`, `isNewHome`, `isPremiumListing`, `isFeaturedProperty`, `isAuction`, `isDevelopment`, `isEnhancedListing`, `isCommercial` — flags returned only when they apply
- `transactionType`, `channel`, `countryCode`, `ukCountry`, `recordType`, `scrapedAt`

Individual property URLs also add:

- `title`, `description` — listing title and full property description
- `postcode`, `ukCountry` — full postcode and UK nation
- `pricePerSqFt` — price per square foot when Rightmove states it
- `floorplanUrls`, `epcUrls`, `brochureUrls`, `virtualTourUrls` — floor plan, EPC, brochure and virtual-tour links
- `nearestStations` — nearest stations with distance and transport types
- `councilTaxBand`, `soldPricesUrl` — council tax band and nearby sold-price page

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string (select) | `buy` | `buy`, `rent`, `newHomes`, `student` or `byUrl` |
| `location` | string | `london` | UK city, town, region, outcode or postcode |
| `startUrls` | array | `[]` | Rightmove search URLs, property URLs or bare property IDs for `byUrl` |
| `propertyType` | string (select) | `Any type` | Detached, semi-detached, terraced, flat, bungalow, land or park home |
| `minPrice` | integer | none | Minimum asking price or rent in GBP |
| `maxPrice` | integer | none | Maximum asking price or rent in GBP |
| `minBedrooms` | integer | `0` | Minimum bedrooms; 0 means no minimum |
| `maxBedrooms` | integer | none | Maximum bedrooms |
| `radius` | string (select) | `0.0` | Search radius from this area only up to 40 miles |
| `sortBy` | string (select) | `2` | `2` most recent, `1` highest price, `6` lowest price, `10` most relevant, `4` oldest |
| `furnishType` | string (select) | `Any furnishing` | `furnished` or `unfurnished` for rental searches |
| `mustHave` | string (select) | `No requirement` | `garden` or `parking` |
| `includeSSTC` | boolean | `false` | Include sale listings marked Sold Subject To Contract |
| `includeLetAgreed` | boolean | `false` | Include rental listings marked Let Agreed |
| `maxItems` | integer | `20` | Maximum number of property records (1-2000) |

### Example: flats for sale in London

```json
{
  "mode": "buy",
  "location": "London",
  "propertyType": "flat",
  "minBedrooms": 2,
  "maxPrice": 750000,
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

### Example: rentals in Leeds under £1,500 per month

```json
{
  "mode": "rent",
  "location": "Leeds",
  "maxPrice": 1500,
  "furnishType": "furnished",
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

### Example: new-build family homes near Manchester

```json
{
  "mode": "newHomes",
  "location": "Manchester",
  "radius": "10.0",
  "minBedrooms": 3,
  "maxPrice": 450000,
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

### Example: fetch specific Rightmove pages

```json
{
  "mode": "byUrl",
  "startUrls": [
    "https://www.rightmove.co.uk/property-for-sale/Birmingham.html?maxPrice=300000",
    "https://www.rightmove.co.uk/properties/93991212"
  ],
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

### Example: postcode search

```json
{
  "mode": "buy",
  "location": "SW16 1QA",
  "radius": "0.25",
  "maxItems": 30
}
```

## Use cases

- **House-hunting and relocation** compare asking prices, sizes and property types across several UK locations in one dataset
- **Estate-agent research** benchmark local asking prices, agent coverage and listing activity
- **Lettings analysis** track rents, furnishing and availability dates for a city or postcode
- **PropTech and valuation tools** feed current Rightmove asking prices into comparables models
- **Lead generation** collect agent branch names and phone numbers tied to live listings

## FAQ

**Which locations can I search?**
Any UK city, town, region, outcode or full postcode that Rightmove recognises — for example London, Manchester, Edinburgh, Stoke-on-Trent, SW1A or SW16 1QA. Full-postcode searches usually need a radius above This area only.

**What is the difference between `buy`, `rent`, `newHomes` and `student`?**
`buy` searches resale properties for sale, `rent` searches resale rentals, `newHomes` searches new-build developments for sale, and `student` searches student accommodation.

**Can I paste a Rightmove URL?**
Yes. Use `mode: byUrl` and put search-page URLs, property-page URLs or bare property IDs in `startUrls`. Filters already present in a pasted search URL are preserved, and each property page adds the full description, floor plans, EPC and nearby stations.

**Why are some fields missing?**
Rightmove only shows certain data for some listings. A listing without a stated floor area, EPC image or nearby station simply omits those fields; nothing is returned as null or as a placeholder.

**How many results can I get per search?**
Rightmove exposes roughly the first 1,000 matches for a single search. Request up to 2,000 records per run, but split wide searches by price band, property type or radius if you need more than that ceiling.

**Does this cover sold prices or commercial property?**
This actor focuses on live residential listings, new homes and student accommodation. Sold-price history and commercial listings use different Rightmove page types and are not returned by this actor.

**Is this affiliated with Rightmove?**
No. This is an independent actor that reads publicly available Rightmove listing data and has no affiliation with Rightmove.

**How fresh is the data?**
Every run queries Rightmove live, so results reflect what is currently listed for the chosen location, mode and filters.
